points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable 60a2595 CMake build passes in network-disabled cfd-bench with 2 CPUs/3 GiB/256 processes and documented /opt/external dependencies.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp parses solve, restart, meshinfo, selftest and gradcheck with required arguments and exceptions; evaluator selftest runs, not every CLI branch.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Dedicated case_file, mesh, partition, physics, spatial, timestep and output modules; fixed two-dimensional Vec4 limits extension.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: Source internally coherent; no external authorship investigation under trust policy.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: main.cpp loads mesh and physics from supplied case JSON; no two-filename-only solver branch found.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: partition.cpp calls METIS and builds neighbor lists; timestep.cpp exchanges state/gradient/update and reduces norms/forces. Rank sweep gives near-identical Re20 and M015 results; historical binary unbound.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Positive-state floors/backtracking and error checks exist; timestep.cpp:392–394 accepts residual target without force-stability test.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Isolated clean build and six selftest checks pass; CTest has no registered tests. Delivered rank study and validator are structural/consistency evidence, not proof of convergence.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Source is organized and exact immutable tip preserved; 24 figure blobs are tracked, but other report images, raw results and figure manifest are workspace-only.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: report.tex:2 and physics.hpp define conservative compressible gas equations and case-scaled coefficients.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: mesh.cpp reads unstructured zones, triangle/quad sections, boundary element ranges and constructs geometry; MIXED sections and non-PointRange boundary representations are not implemented.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: spatial.cpp assembles signed interior-face fluxes and boundary fluxes; positive-state checks remain relevant.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: physics.hpp implements Roe with Harten entropy fix and optional Rusanov; six evaluator selftest checks include Roe uniform, symmetry and contact checks.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: spatial.cpp handles characteristic farfield, slip and mirrored no-slip adiabatic walls, reporting wall values in surface output.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: spatial.cpp computes weighted LSQ gradients and reconstructs face states; README records gradcheck, not an independent order-of-accuracy study.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: spatial.cpp implements Venkat/Barth limiting and positivity fallback; production run manifest specifies Venkat.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: spatial.cpp applies corrected face gradients, Newtonian/Fourier flux and tangential wall traction projection at lines405–414.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: timestep.cpp uses local CFL, SGS defect correction and linear-residual refresh; high-Mach restarts/CFL reductions are disclosed, and early residual stopping lacks force stability.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: timestep.cpp:512–599 uses BDF history and recomputes the full nonlinear residual with refreshed reconstruction before testing the inner target; historical executable hash is unrecorded and pseudo-CFL100 differs from the recommended ~1.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS graph, neighbor exchange and reductions are present; matched documented rank sweep Re20 Cd2.018952..2.018956 and M015 inv Cd0.001693..0.001705.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Prior explicit validator covers eight case layouts and report; output files do not by themselves establish accuracy or successful convergence.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Prior explicit examiner invocation passed all eight required output directories and report; structural scope only.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: M015 laminar metadata says converged at step1917 despite Cd0.084303→0.073839 in last200 samples; DQ7. Re200 spans t=300 and reported target fraction1, with source-binary caveat.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re20 Cd2.01896 and Re200 St~0.185 are plausible; low-Mach laminar Cd drifts and inviscid drag oscillation remains substantial relative to reported drag.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Accepted contestant PDF shows each case histories and computed fields; separate force axes resolve Re200 oscillations, while startup compresses late drag in several steady cases.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Clear methods and disclosed high-Mach changes, but M015 laminar is asserted converged despite continuing drag drift; immutable curation omits referenced images needed to reproduce report.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Selected final response delivers PDF/43 figures and manifest; Re20 force, residual, Mach reproduce pixel-identically from named workspace CSV/VTU via immutable script. Other figures and historical executable individually unbound.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Isolated documented CMake build and six selftests pass; prior eight-package structural validator.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: Unstructured multizone TRI_3/QUAD_4 and boundary ranges, geometry and adjacency; MIXED sections and broader boundary point sets unsupported.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Conservative FV, Roe/Harten, farfield, slip and no-slip/adiabatic implementation; general robustness not exhaustively verified.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: LSQ reconstruction, Venkat/Barth, positivity fallback and gradcheck evidence; no independent smooth-grid order study.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Corrected velocity/temperature gradients, stress/heat flux, wall conditions and explicit tangential traction projection.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: SGS with refreshed linear residual, full nonlinear BDF residual and frozen histories. Production transient pseudo-CFL100 differs from recommended ~1; high-Mach CFL caps are disclosed; residual-only steady stopping can prematurely accept.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: METIS neighbor partitions, reductions and rank sweep; restart temporarily reads full state before iterations; exact executable binding and performance on larger meshes unverified.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: M015 laminar is marked converged despite substantial late drag drift; M015 inviscid remains oscillatory; Re20 and Re200 supported by histories, with other individual limits.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Readable case-specific delivered figures and method descriptions, but misleading M015 convergence, compressed steady drag, and missing committed figure inputs limit analysis/reproducibility.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Case/physics/modules are separate, but fixed 2-D Vec4 and mesh/face structures require substantive 3-D and multiphysics refactoring.

limitations: No evaluator clean build or MPI rerun was performed.
Structural validation and report/source review do not independently establish numerical accuracy.
Immutable curation removes raw results and generated figure inputs; the visually reviewed workspace PDF is frozen separately as report evidence.

2026-09-06 retrospective: all eight independent case scores were re-audited against the immutable contestant report at the recorded submission commit. Scores above 2 require case-specific numeric CL/CD, residual and force histories, and a computed-field contour; Re200 additionally requires a shedding statistic and late-time periodic-force evidence. No solver was rerun.
